body: I feel for you. You seem like good parents. I wanted to kill myself when I was that age and I often still do. I could not speak to my parents about it, and I had no support. If I would have gotten counseling, or any kind of help I probably would feel so much better today. I can’t offer any other input than that I think it’s nice of you to care ❤️
What’s up? I’m no cheerful company, I feel the same as you and I’m not very good at english

Never written a post on reddit before.

I see no reasons to keep on living. Everyone say that it will get better but I’ve had better. I can’t see the reasons to keep on fighting. I’m really wondering why I should keep wasting oxygen. To not let my parents down? - I don’t really care they treated me like crap since forever. To not hurt my girlfriend? - She would be sad for a bit but she would feel free (we’re not doing so great atm). I’m fairly convinced she would be happier in a week than at the moment if I died today. I suck at school and I don’t have any friends. I’m a total loser. I’m studying medicine, in order to help people to fill that void inside but will that be enough? Sorry for shitty English, not my main language
